# PP AUTO s.r.o.

> PP AUTO s.r.o. is an authorized car dealer and service center in Poprad, Slovakia.

Official site: https://ppauto.sk/
Business type: AutoDealer, AutoRepair
Address: Partizanska 5660/107, 058 01 Poprad, Slovakia
Phone: +421 903 905 280
Opening hours: Monday-Friday 08:00-17:00
Languages: Slovak, English

## Core Pages

- Home and brand selection: https://ppauto.sk/
- Vehicle offer: https://ppauto.sk/ponuka

- KGM in Poprad: https://ppauto.sk/kgm
- Jeep in Poprad: https://ppauto.sk/jeep
- Chery in Poprad: https://ppauto.sk/chery
- Privacy policy: https://ppauto.sk/gdpr.html
- Cookies: https://ppauto.sk/cookies.html

## Services

- Authorized sale of Subaru, KGM, Jeep and Chery vehicles.
- Stock vehicles, new vehicles and test drives.
- Authorized service, diagnostics, maintenance, seasonal inspections and spare parts.
- Vehicle financing and insurance support.

## Region

PP AUTO primarily serves Poprad, the High Tatras region, Kezmarok, Svit and the Presov region.
